name: flat_walking_strong_end_stops
description: Flat floor, walking speeds 0.2 to 0.7 m/s, and a doubled cost for resting joints on their end stops
notes: Duck 4's fourth run (from_run_3). Like flat_walking_end_stops but with twice the end stop weight (0.1): at 0.05 he only moved his toes off their stops and kept 8 joints (neck, hip swings, hip sides, ankles) on theirs about 97% of the time. In his crouch (about 7 joints at their stops) this costs about 0.7 points per step: walking at 0.45 m/s still nets about 0.6 per step, but at 0.2 m/s a crouched step nets slightly below zero, so watch for falling on purpose.
